svg.title: Read nearby and designated distant positions
svg.desc: Two 8×8 causal masks. A combines local 3, including the current position, with anchor 0. B combines local 3 with positions divisible by 4. At row 7 the read sets are A={0,5,6,7} and B={0,4,5,6,7}, with overlaps counted once.
svg.text: Teal marks local positions; purple marks
positions count only once. Neither rule
reads the future; these are not copies
of a bidirectional encoder’s global mask.
